text:
Service date: 19th
Initially, I booked the 999 baht tie pin.
But at the clinic, I changed my mind and opted for the Mounjaro pen tie pin.
Because I've had it done elsewhere before.
The staff informed me that the 999 baht tie pin wasn't the same as the pen.
Upon arrival, I encountered a staff member trying to sell me a course of treatments.
However, it wasn't convenient for me, so I opted for the pen tie pin as before.
But because I also requested a tummy massage, the staff member added that.
The total bill came to 3000 baht.
The staff collected payment before the procedure.
I thought I would have everything done at the same time.
But after I paid, the staff informed me that
the doctor wasn't in, and I should get the tummy massage first 😡😡😡
and then come back on Saturday for the tie pin tie pin 😡😡
I was very unhappy because it was my due date for the tie pin tie, but I had already paid, so I thought, "Whatever, I'll come back on Saturday."

😡😡😡 On Saturday, there was no discussion at all. I just went in, had the tie pin inserted, without any explanation of the medication or anything. They just injected it. Other clinics I've been to before... They showed me the brand of the injected substance.

And how many mg were used.

But after the injection, there was absolutely nothing. It didn't control my appetite, nothing at all.
I'm so confused about what they injected.

I'm very disappointed and unimpressed.

It had no effect whatsoever.

Customer service and honesty with customers are very important.

3000 baht isn't a small amount. I spent a whole month getting my hair done.

But I wanted to do it because it was close to my workplace.
I didn't want to travel far.

If they were honest with their customers, they should have informed me beforehand that the doctor wasn't available.

They collected the money beforehand, even though nothing had been done.

This is a warning to anyone considering getting treatment at this clinic.

I'm not biased; I'm speaking from a pure heart.
Experiencing this makes me so sad.

Other places I went to before were cheaper.

But I chose to go there because it was close to my workplace.
